name: Craftsmen's Terrace
summary: Workshops and visitors gather along Darnassus's northern edge at Craftsmen's Terrace. Its trainers, inn, and Argent Dawn embassy serve artisans and travelers.

sections.title: The Artisan Heart of Darnassus
sections.body: Woodworkers, leathercrafters, alchemists, and other artisans work along Darnassus's northern edge. Their shops gather the trades that keep the city running, with night elven methods put to practical use. An inn, a guild master, and guild petition vendors serve visitors here. Bridges lead west to the Cenarion Enclave and south to the Warrior's Terrace.

sections.title: Outside Ties and Forgotten Lore
sections.body: The Argent Dawn keeps an embassy in the Craftsmen's Terrace and coordinates with northern allies against the Scourge. Scattered scholarly volumes rest among the workshops. They include histories of the War of the Ancients, chronicles of the Second War, and treatises on the Old Gods.

faq.q: What services are found in the Craftsmen's Terrace?
faq.answer: Trade profession trainers, craft supply merchants, an inn, and guild registry services can all be found in the Craftsmen's Terrace. Travelers come to learn or practice practical skills in Darnassus.

faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn present in the Craftsmen's Terrace?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn keeps an embassy in the Craftsmen's Terrace to liaise with the night elves and recruit aid against the Scourge. It connects Alliance forces in the west with the war-torn lands of Lordaeron.

faq.q: How do you reach the Craftsmen's Terrace?
aliases: how to get to craftsmen terrace
faq.answer: The Craftsmen's Terrace fills Darnassus's northern section. Bridges lead north from the Warrior's Terrace and east from the Cenarion Enclave.

faq.q: What notable books can be found around the workshops?
faq.answer: Scholarly volumes in the workshops include histories of the War of the Ancients, accounts of the aftermath of the Second War, and a study of the Old Gods in the Argent Dawn's quarters.

angles.text: As a kaldorei, you see the terrace's self-reliance on Teldrassil, where ancient craftsmanship meets the daily needs of the new capital.
As an Alliance visitor, you find trade supplies, guild services, and lodging in one of Darnassus's most welcoming quarters. Foreign representatives have a place here too.
